source_text: Orietur stella ex Iacob et consurget virga de Israel. Christus stella matutina praefiguratur.
pass_a_gloss: Will-rise star from Jacob and will-arise rod from Israel. Christ star morning is-prefigured.
pass_b_english: [[A star shall rise out of Jacob, a rod out of Israel >> Bible:Numbers 24:17]] — Christ the morning star prefigured.
